name: Tomas
thought: Jasper's eyes keep finding me across the square, and I still owe him 90 coin I don't have. I need to earn coin before he or Mum starts asking questions.

name: Caleb
thought: I've got food in the woods nobody knows about, so I keep quiet and watch who's desperate. Hunting earns coin and meat without drawing eyes.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas owes me 90 and he is the deputy, so he can make trouble for me in the open. I'll press him quietly in private and keep my hand hidden until he pays.

name: Fenn
thought: Two food and five coin won't carry me through a famine, and I want Nell to see me as someone who can provide. Silas's fields pay the surest coin, so I'll work there before the market prices climb.

name: Roz
thought: Food will run out before the gossip does. I'll buy while the market still has stock, and keep Dov's little secret to myself.

name: Mara
thought: Eighteen units of food won't last a famine, and if the square panics it will turn on me. I need to look like the one who has this in hand, and I need to keep my coin ready for Tomas.

name: Nell
thought: Everyone is standing in the square, and my father sits on grain while the poor go hungry. I won't get a better audience than this, so I'm saying it now.

name: Marta
thought: Food runs out first in a famine, and Fenn must eat even if I go short. I'll spend what I carry on food before the market empties, and keep the 6 coin hidden at home for getting him out.

name: Isla
thought: Everyone's crowded in the square and the market only has 18 units for twenty hungry mouths. Food will be worth more than coin by tonight, so I'm buying before the rush and working for the rest later.

name: Elena
thought: Three meals won't carry me through a famine, and the market will be stripped by noon. I'll buy what I can while there's stock, and keep some coin back.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla's 60-coin tab is my leverage, and the famine makes her desperate enough to bargain. I'll press her quietly so nobody learns about the watered ale.

name: Gideon
thought: Everyone's here, Elena and Isla both, and I can't stand under both their eyes at once. Better to slip off to the ovens, keep my hands busy and my face normal, and bake bread this town will need.

name: Corin
thought: Food runs out fast and the market won't cover everyone. I buy while there's stock, because hungry men don't back a captain. Then I start counting who would stand behind me over Dov.

name: Silas
thought: Food is cheap now and will be gold when the famine bites. I'll take a good share of the market stock before the crowd thinks to, and sell it back later at my price.

name: Bram
thought: Two of my friends are in the ground because Silas worked them into the dirt, and now the market is pricing bread out of working people's reach. I want the town to hear it from me before the famine decides for us.

name: Dov
thought: Famine's coming and Mother has to eat. Better to buy while the stock lasts and sort out Silas's cellar later.

name: Hester
thought: Everyone is gathered, frightened and hungry, and fear makes thieves of decent people; I know that better than any of them. I'll speak now, hard words in public, before the hoarding and knives begin.

name: Wren
thought: Everyone here is already counting sacks, so I should look like I'm just making small talk while I learn who guards the walls and when. I still have 2 food and 30 coin, so I don't need to panic-buy yet.

name: Magnus
thought: Food is what kills people first in a famine, and the market has only 18 units for the whole town. I'll buy enough to be safe, keep my coin hidden at home, and watch Silas closely because his ledgers are the real danger to me.

name: Priya
thought: Dov and Tomas are standing right here, and theft means jail, so I won't touch anyone's purse in this crowd. I have food for tonight, but with 18 units left and the famine coming, I'd rather not be hungry tomorrow.

name: Caleb
thought: Market's empty and every mouth here is counting. I keep my head down and say nothing about the smoked meat in the woods. Hunting turns out more food and coin, and I'll need both before this is over.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas owes me 90 coin and is standing right here with a deputy's badge, so I'll remind him quietly before the famine makes everyone desperate to keep what they have.

name: Magnus
thought: Nell has seen the ledgers, and Silas is the one who will hang if the cellar is found. I need the grain moved and my name kept out of the books before Dov comes looking.

name: Mara
thought: Silas's hoarded grain is the scapegoat I need, and every eye on him is one less eye on the treasury ledger and the coin I've been moving for Tomas. I have to look like the one who acts, not the one who is afraid.

name: Corin
thought: Silas is exposed and afraid, and a frightened man with a full granary will pay for protection and back whoever shields him. I'll take his coin and his support, and put him in my count against Dov.

name: Isla
thought: I'm 4 coin short of Ezra's 60, but food is worth more than coin in a famine, so I'll offer him bread. And if he's been tampering with my casks, that's something I can use against him.

name: Fenn
thought: Nell spoke up when it was hard, and I want her to see that I stand with her. I have three loaves, more than many here, so I should be the one pushing for a fair share.

name: Bram
thought: The market is empty and Silas's granary is the reason. A welfare law gets food to working people now, and it puts Silas on the spot in front of everyone.

name: Marta
thought: The market is empty and I have five days of bread. I need coin to get Fenn out, and I can't afford to cough in front of this crowd, so I'll work and keep quiet.

name: Ezra
thought: I have six units put by and forty coin on me, and Silas's hoarding has the whole square looking for a villain. Better to sound reasonable and keep my own stores and my tabs out of it.

name: Hester
thought: Silas's grain is the only bread left in this town, and if Mara will not open it, the hungry will break it open themselves and blood will follow. Better I shame it open from the pulpit than watch them do it with knives.

name: Nell
thought: I've named my father in front of everyone, and now it needs to turn into something real. Bram wants welfare, and the treasury has coin that should reach the hungry before Silas's grain does.

name: Silas
thought: Nell has put a knife in my back, and the crowd will want my cellar opened. Dov is bought, so he has to keep the sheriff's badge between them and my grain, and I want Bram contained before the mob listens to him.

name: Tomas
thought: Jasper is standing right there with ninety coin on his mind, and I have fifteen. If Mara hears about this debt, I'm finished, so I need to buy time without sounding desperate.

name: Priya
thought: The stalls are empty and Dov is standing right there, so I can't risk a pickpocket now. I have two food at home for tonight, so I'll trade my sewing for food later instead.

name: Wren
thought: The market is empty and I hold two loaves, enough for me, so I should keep them quiet. Asking who counts the granary tells me where the food really is without showing my hand.

name: Roz
thought: Dov's taking Silas's coin while the town is shouting about Silas's grain. If anyone digs, my boy goes down with him. I'll warn him quietly and keep my own food close.

name: Elena
thought: The market is empty and I have six units, enough for now. Gideon is standing a few feet away and I can't look at him yet. I'll do the work I can, because coin and a steady head will matter more than a scene in the square.

name: Gideon
thought: Elena and Isla in the same crowd makes my stomach turn. I'll keep my head down, keep my hands in the dough, and be the baker everyone needs too much to suspect of anything.

name: Dov
thought: Nell's exposure puts Silas and me both at risk, since if he falls my bribes surface. The crowd will want grain, and my mother needs food. I'll squeeze Silas privately for food for Roz and push him to release some grain so the town stays calm.

name: Marta
thought: The market is empty and half the town is hungry and watching each other's pockets. I'll get home with my food and put these last coins in the stash before someone's fingers find them. Every coin is Fenn's way out.

name: Ezra
thought: Isla's threat to expose my watered casks is the only thing that could ruin me, so I need her settled tonight before she talks. I'll take her offer of coin and bread at the tavern, and make sure she knows the tab is mine to collect.

name: Corin
thought: Market's dry and I'm holding six units while half this square is starving. I'll keep that quiet, get off the street before someone gets ideas, and save my strength. Dov and Mara can fumble the granary while I count who'd follow me.

name: Bram
thought: Welfare is the only thing that keeps the workers fed tonight, and my own proposal needs to be on record as passed before the square empties. I'll stay here and vote it through.

name: Isla
thought: I'm four coin short of Ezra's sixty, and handing over the tavern is out of the question. He sold me those casks, so whatever he's put in them is his sin as much as mine. I'll offer him nearly all of it and remind him he can be exposed too.

name: Magnus
thought: Silas is going down, and the count will find his cellar, so I need to be seen as the honest miller who only ground the grain. My own share has to stay hidden, and my food has to last me through the night.

name: Nell
thought: Father's grain is out in the open now, and Mara has promised a count. I have to keep the pressure on tonight, or he'll move the sacks before dawn.

name: Priya
thought: I have only one spare food unit after tonight's meal, and the market is empty with Dov watching. Silas is sitting on a full granary that the whole square is about to seize, so I'll slip into his house after dark and take what I can before the count.

name: Dov
thought: Silas is under every eye and Mother is right, I can't be seen near his coin now. I'll go to her house as she asked, empty-handed, and slip her some food, since the market is bare and she matters more than my stores.

name: Fenn
thought: I have three loaves and only need one tonight, so I can spare two. Nell spoke for the hungry this morning when I couldn't, and I want her to know I'm on her side.

name: Tomas
thought: Jasper will not wait forever, and I cannot find ninety coin tonight. Handing him what I have buys time, and I still have food for three nights.

name: Caleb
thought: Ten units of food and a smokehouse in the woods that nobody knows about. I'll keep my mouth shut, go home and eat, and stay out of the squabbling over Silas's grain.

name: Silas
thought: The cellar is exposed and the crowd is turning. Dov is already bought, and a sack to his mother is cheap next to losing the lot. I'll make him earn it by keeping the watch off my cellar and putting Bram where he can't stir the square.

name: Jasper
thought: Tomas owes me 90 and he is standing right here with the deputy's badge, which makes him easy to squeeze. Coin buys food when the stalls are empty, so I'll press him now while he's cornered.

name: Gideon
thought: Elena's right here and Isla is close enough to touch, so I must look like nothing but the good-hearted baker everyone knows. Ten loaves is more than one man needs tonight, and bread given openly is the best cover there is.

name: Roz
thought: Silas is going down and Dov's pocket is full of Silas's coin. If the granary count points back at my boy, I'll be the one who pays for it. Better he hears it from his mother, quietly, tonight.

name: Wren
thought: The market is bare and the square is split between Silas's granary and Mara's promises, which is exactly the weakness my crew paid me to find. I'll send them the picture while I still have two loaves tucked away.

name: Mara
thought: If the granary count goes badly or someone starts digging through the treasury books, my skimming for Tomas comes out with it. I need the town calm and looking at Silas, not at my ledgers.

name: Hester
thought: The treasury does no good sitting in Mara's strongbox while bellies go empty. Let my vote stand where my sermons stand.

name: Elena
thought: I have six units and the market is bare. Priya is mending hems for bread, so she's hungry. One unit costs me little, and it keeps a neighbor alive and gives me someone who owes me. Gideon is standing right here, and I'm saying nothing to him yet.
